knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(seasonal)

# Make sure the figures folder exists before any ggsave() below
dir.create(here("output", "state_space_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load the cleaned inflation series

```{r}
pi_2023 <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "headline_pi_2023base.rds"))
pi_ts   <- ts(pi_2023$pi, start = c(2010, 2), frequency = 12)
```

## Fit the local level model

```{r}
fit <- StructTS(pi_ts, type = "level")
fit$coef
```

## Interpret the estimates: signal-to-noise and Kalman gain

```{r}
q <- unname(fit$coef["level"] / fit$coef["epsilon"])    # signal-to-noise ratio
K <- (-q + sqrt(q^2 + 4 * q)) / 2                       # share of each surprise absorbed into trend
c(q = q, K = K,
  sd_step  = sqrt(unname(fit$coef["level"])),
  sd_noise = sqrt(unname(fit$coef["epsilon"])))
```

## Plot headline inflation against the filtered and smoothed trend

```{r}
results <- pi_2023 |>
  mutate(filtered = as.numeric(fitted(fit)),
         smoothed = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit)))

p_trend_raw <- results |>
  pivot_longer(c(pi, filtered, smoothed)) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line()
p_trend_raw
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "local_level_unadjusted.png"),
       p_trend_raw, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Check for seasonality: average inflation by calendar month

```{r}
pi_2023 |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(avg_pi = mean(pi), sd_pi = sd(pi))
```

```{r}
p_seasonal <- pi_2023 |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(month, pi)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey20", width = 0.6,
               outlier.size = 1.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2,
               fill = "white", colour = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Annualized monthly inflation (%)",
       caption = "Source: National Statistics Office of Mongolia; author's calculations.") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30", size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
p_seasonal

ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "seasonality_by_month.png"),
       p_seasonal, width = 6.5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "seasonality_by_month.pdf"),
       p_seasonal, width = 6.5, height = 3.5)
```

## Seasonally adjust the CPI index with X-13

```{r}
index_ts <- ts(pi_2023$index, start = c(2010, 2), frequency = 12)
sa       <- seas(index_ts)
index_sa <- final(sa)
```

## Seasonally adjusted monthly inflation

```{r}
pi_sa_ts <- 1200 * diff(log(index_sa))
```

## Refit the local level model on adjusted inflation

```{r}
fit_sa <- StructTS(pi_sa_ts, type = "level")

q_sa <- unname(fit_sa$coef["level"] / fit_sa$coef["epsilon"])
K_sa <- (-q_sa + sqrt(q_sa^2 + 4 * q_sa)) / 2
c(q = q_sa, K = K_sa,
  sd_step  = sqrt(unname(fit_sa$coef["level"])),
  sd_noise = sqrt(unname(fit_sa$coef["epsilon"])))
```

## Filtered and smoothed trend, seasonally adjusted

```{r}
results_sa <- tibble(
  date     = seq(ym("2010-03"), ym("2026-08"), by = "month"),
  pi_sa    = as.numeric(pi_sa_ts),
  filtered = as.numeric(fitted(fit_sa)),
  smoothed = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit_sa)))


p_trend_sa <- results_sa |>
  pivot_longer(c(pi_sa, filtered, smoothed)) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line()
p_trend_sa
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "local_level_sa.png"),
       p_trend_sa, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

saveRDS(results_sa, here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))
```

## Convert the trend to a year-over-year basis

```{r}
results_sa <- results_sa |>
  mutate(trend_yoy = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(filtered, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1))

headline_yoy <- pi_2023 |>
  mutate(headline_yoy = 100 * (index / lag(index, 12) - 1)) |>
  select(date, headline_yoy)
```

## Load and clean Mongolbank's published inflation series

```{r}
boa_raw <- read_excel(here("data", "trimmed_mean", "inflation-rate.xlsx"),
                      sheet = 1, skip = 2, col_names = FALSE)
names(boa_raw) <- c("date_raw", "national_mom", "national_yoy",
                    "ub_mom", "ub_yoy", "core_mom", "core_yoy")

boa <- boa_raw |>
  mutate(is_corrupted = str_detect(date_raw, "^\\d+$"),
         month = if_else(is_corrupted,
                         paste0(format(as.Date(as.numeric(date_raw), origin = "1899-12-30"), "%Y"), "-01"),
                         str_sub(date_raw, 1, -2)),
         date = ym(month)) |>
  select(date, national_mom:core_yoy) |>
  arrange(date)

saveRDS(boa, here("data", "state_space", "mongolbank_inflation.rds"))
```

## Validation: NSO-derived headline vs Mongolbank's published headline

```{r}
headline_yoy |>
  inner_join(boa, by = "date") |>
  summarise(max_gap = max(abs(headline_yoy - national_yoy), na.rm = TRUE),
            cor     = cor(headline_yoy, national_yoy, use = "complete.obs"))
```

## Where does the headline gap come from?

```{r}
headline_yoy |>
  inner_join(boa, by = "date") |>
  mutate(gap = headline_yoy - national_yoy) |>
  group_by(year = year(date)) |>
  summarise(mean_abs_gap = mean(abs(gap), na.rm = TRUE),
            max_abs_gap  = max(abs(gap), na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Compare the state-space trend with headline and Mongolbank's core

```{r}
comparison <- results_sa |>
  select(date, trend_yoy) |>
  left_join(headline_yoy, by = "date") |>
  left_join(select(boa, date, core_yoy), by = "date") |>
  filter(date >= ym("2017-01"))

p_compare <- comparison |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Year-over-year inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_compare
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "trend_vs_headline_core.png"),
       p_compare, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

saveRDS(comparison, here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy.rds"))
```

## Figure 3: trend before and after seasonal adjustment

```{r}
fig3_data <- bind_rows(
  results    |> transmute(date, panel = "A. Unadjusted inflation",
                          inflation = pi, filtered, smoothed),
  results_sa |> transmute(date, panel = "B. Seasonally adjusted inflation",
                          inflation = pi_sa, filtered, smoothed)
) |>
  pivot_longer(c(inflation, filtered, smoothed)) |>
  mutate(name = factor(name,
           levels = c("inflation", "filtered", "smoothed"),
           labels = c("Monthly inflation (annualized)",
                      "Filtered trend (real time)",
                      "Smoothed trend (full sample)")))

p_fig3 <- ggplot(fig3_data, aes(date, value, colour = name, linetype = name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "#1f4e79", "#c0504d")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "solid", "dashed")) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annualized monthly inflation (%)", colour = NULL, linetype = NULL,
       caption = "Source: National Statistics Office of Mongolia; author's calculations.") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30", size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
p_fig3

ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "fig3_trend_unadjusted_vs_sa.png"),
       p_fig3, width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "fig3_trend_unadjusted_vs_sa.pdf"),
       p_fig3, width = 6.5, height = 6.5)
```

## Table 2: estimates before and after seasonal adjustment

```{r}
tab2 <- tibble(
  Parameter = c("Trend step, $\\sigma_\\varepsilon$", "Noise, $\\sigma_\\eta$",
                "Signal-to-noise ratio, $q$", "Kalman gain, $K$"),
  Unadjusted = c(sqrt(fit$coef["level"]), sqrt(fit$coef["epsilon"]), q, K),
  `Seasonally adjusted` = c(sqrt(fit_sa$coef["level"]), sqrt(fit_sa$coef["epsilon"]), q_sa, K_sa)
)

knitr::kable(tab2, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, digits = 2, escape = FALSE,
             caption = "Local level model estimates, before and after seasonal adjustment")
```
